findings.issue: tasks.md task 3.1 claims 'all 72 tests, including the App mount-point integration tests, pass' but no test renders <App /> and asserts FooterVersionBadge is mounted; command-palette/app-integration.test.tsx (the cited precedent) does not cover it either. Requirement 5 (mount exactly once, alongside CommandPalette, no other mount site) is untested, and the task log's completion claim is inaccurate.
findings.fix_hint: Add an App-mount integration test analogous to command-palette/app-integration.test.tsx: render <App />, assert the version badge text is present exactly once, and assert existing App markup is unchanged. Correct the task log's false claim.

findings.issue: typeof __APP_VERSION__ !== 'undefined' ? __APP_VERSION__ : 'unknown' diverges from the approved design's concrete shape (plain v{__APP_VERSION__}). The 'unknown' fallback is unreachable in any real build (vite.config.ts always injects the define; verified production bundle only contains '0.0.0') and is never exercised by any test (all tests stub the global).
findings.fix_hint: Remove the typeof guard and use __APP_VERSION__ directly per design.md, or if the Vitest-environment gap is intentional, formally amend the design doc to include the guard and add a test that exercises the 'unknown' fallback path.
